headline: CBA Predicts Perth Home Prices to Fall 18 Percent Amid Market Slump
summary: Commonwealth Bank of Australia forecasts that Perth home prices could drop 18 percent, offering potential relief for buyers amid sliding property valuations.
why: Commonwealth Bank of Australia is the country's largest retail bank, making its housing market forecasts a key indicator for domestic mortgage lending and consumer wealth trends.

impacts.name: Commonwealth Bank of Australia
impacts.why: Slumping regional property prices affect loan-to-value ratios and housing credit growth for major lenders.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
